meta.source: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education), via MoSPI eSankhyiki
meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each survey year is a cross-section; the five years (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index.
meta.coverage: All India; universities, colleges, estimated student enrolment (Grand Total, Both), teachers, GER (All Categories, Both), GPI (All Categories), PTR (Regular and Distance, All Institutions)
meta.note: Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. The five AISHE rounds served by the eSankhyiki API (2017-18 to 2021-22) are comparable by design but are never chained into a spliced index. GER (Gross Enrolment Ratio) = enrolled students ÷ the college-age population × 100; it is gross, so it can exceed 100. GPI (Gender Parity Index) = female GER ÷ male GER; 1.0 is parity. Teachers are the published 'All Teacher' total in every year, which equals the five regular posts plus visiting teachers.
